# Erasmus+

> Official portal for Erasmus+, the European Union's flagship programme for education, training, youth and sport mobility and cooperation across Europe.

Erasmus+ supports millions of students, learners, and youth workers through study abroad opportunities, joint master's degrees like Erasmus Mundus, and project funding. The programme aligns with EU policy frameworks including the European Education Area, Digital Education Action Plan, and EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027.

## Key Topics

- Erasmus+
- European Union education programmes
- Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
- ECTS (European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System)
- Student mobility and exchange
- EU funding for education projects
- Study abroad opportunities
- European Education Area
- Digital Education Action Plan
- European Skills Agenda
- EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
- International scholarships
- Youth workers and trainers
- European Pillar of Social Rights
- Cross-border learning cooperation

## Getting Started

- [Home - Erasmus+](https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/): Homepage for EU's education, training, youth and sport programme
- [What is Erasmus+? - Erasmus+](https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/about-erasmus/what-is-erasmus): Introduction to Erasmus+ programme covering education and youth mobility

## Opportunities for Individuals

- [Opportunities for individuals - Erasmus+](https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/opportunities/opportunities-for-individuals): Overview of Erasmus+ opportunities for students, youth workers, learners
- [Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (students) - Erasmus+](https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/opportunities/opportunities-for-individuals/students/erasmus-mundus-joint-masters): Guide to Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters applications and course catalog

## Projects and Funding

- [Projects - Erasmus+](https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/projects): Searchable database of completed and ongoing EU-funded Erasmus+ projects
